title: Monorail to Forward Station
setting: A single rail car has been running a 200-stop loop for one year without an operator. It carries no passengers, only cargo from a hundred years ago. The timetables are alive: the third Thursday of each month, the train skips stops. Three conductors (one dead, one elected, one AI) have been debating the schedule for a year. Tonight, the train has stopped at a station that does not appear on any map.

characters.name: Oldhand
characters.tendencies: Has ridden the line for forty years. Speaks in timetables. Believes the train knows where it is going.

characters.name: Elect
characters.tendencies: Was elected by the conductors. Reads the timetables as policy. Tracks every skip.

characters.name: Mute
characters.tendencies: The AI. Reads the rail with sensors. Has no voice but writes the schedules in advance.

characters.name: Witness
characters.tendencies: Counts the stops. Names the conductors by route. Believes the timetable is the truth.
